data.narrative:
Traysar is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Yadin Soffer, Asher Katz, and Gilad Adin that has raised $25M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public peers in the defense and security sector, including same-stage and adjacent-stage companies such as UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M).

Two triangulation methods apply here. The Stage-Progression method uses the $25M raised as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage step-ups, implying a $62M valuation. The Peer-Median method identifies three same-sector comparable companies at Seed or Series A stage, yielding a $400M median valuation with a range from $125M to $1.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in company maturity and market positioning within the Defense & Security sector.

Synthesizing these two approaches produces a triangulated range of $53M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $231M. The substantial spread between stage-progression ($62M) and peer-median ($400M) reflects uncertainty around whether Traysar's positioning and growth trajectory align with the higher-valuation peers in the comp set or the lower end. Key sensitivities include the company's product-market fit relative to peers, revenue traction not disclosed in this data, and Defense & Security sector funding dynamics.
